notes: The waw of s005 is read as carrying the whole subordinator *in that* under rule 55's one-rendering reading; the alternative gives *in* to the waw and marks *that* added, which the surplus count does not support since the two words are contiguous and form one connective.
t029 *it* is italic in the ASV and answers to no object morpheme, so it is added under rule 44.
The two אוֹ are counted against the ASV's *whether ... or*: one English connective per morpheme, so rule 14's correlative-pair clause is not reached.
